newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kinkel congratulates Izetbegovic on poll result.
newsitem.headline: Kinkel congratulates Izetbegovic on poll result.

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel congratulated Bosnia's Moslem President Alija Izetbegovic on Wednesday after election results showed he had become the first head of Bosnia's new collective presidency.

Kinkel said he hoped the election will mark the start of an era of political normalcy in Bosnia and told Izetbegovic in a telegram that he looked forward to working together with him again in the future.

"I hope history will show these elections were the start of political normalcy in Bosnia and Herzegovina," Kinkel said. "Your nation has now also come closer to the goal of peaceful cooperation, a goal you worked so hard for in recent years."
Kinkel said it was now important for Bosnia to create functioning institutions.

The Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE), which organised the election, said the completed count gave Izetbegovic 729,034 votes and hardline Bosnian Serb rival Momcilo Krajisnik 690,373.
